# Router documentation ownership

The public Router guides use `development/comfy-router/`. The old
`/comfy-router-*` URLs redirect there; do not recreate independent copies.

The cloud repository owns the sources for three pages:

| Published page | Source in Comfy-Org/cloud |
| --- | --- |
| `development/comfy-router/quickstart.mdx` | `services/comfy-api/docs/router-quickstart.mdx` |
| `development/comfy-router/limitations.mdx` | `services/comfy-api/docs/router-limitations.mdx` |
| `development/comfy-router/reference.mdx` | Generated `services/comfy-api/docs/router-reference.mdx` |

The reference is generated by `services/comfy-api/scripts/gen_router_reference.py`
from `services/comfy-api/openapi.yml`. Edit its upstream descriptions or generator and
regenerate rather than hand-editing the published copy. The cloud workflow
`.github/workflows/push-v2-spec-to-sdks.yml` synchronizes these three files and the
model schemas. Authored guide changes must also be made in the cloud sources so
the next sync preserves them.

`models.mdx` (Using the Comfy Router API), `headers.mdx`, shared snippets, and
navigation are owned by this docs repository. Its model, schema, validation,
result, retry, and billing sections replace the former Reliability page.
Per-model Code pages are generated using
the [snippet tooling](../snippets/README.md).

Run `pnpm router:check` to check canonical navigation, redirects, and Router
routes against the example model schema. Run `pnpm code-pages:check` to check
generated freshness and parse Python, TypeScript, and Bash snippets in both
model pages and Router guides. These checks do not invoke models or incur
generation charges.

`python3 .github/scripts/router/reliability_examples_test.py` executes the
published error-parsing and collection examples against a fake HTTP client.
It covers malformed responses, retained-key collection, terminal conflicts,
missing retry hints, and attempt limits without sending any network requests.
